title: Batch minimap rendering вЂ” cached 1x1 dot surfaces
details: main.py minimap uses per-pixel set_at() every frame. Create cached 1x1 dot surfaces per class and blit them instead. Also cache the minimap surface between frames instead of recreating.
notes: Minimap optimization: (1) Cached map_surf before loop — reuse Surface instead of creating new one each frame; (2) Cached 1x1 dot surfaces per (diet, cls) via _dot_cache + _make_dot, blit instead of set_at; (3) Cached _corpses_dot (1x1, (150,90,90)) and _sel_cross (5x5 crosshair); (4) Simplified diet_color lookup (removed 3-way if/elif). set_at reduced from ~11 per frame to 2 init-only calls. Tests passed.
